question: What happens to the yogin who devours time, and what is time?
premises: A yogin intent on devouring time instantly becomes a sky-mover.
Time is the appearance of things.
That appearance of things is of the nature of limitation.
inference: Because time is limiting appearance, the yogin who devours it attains the freedom of a sky-mover.
plain_english: The yogin devoted to devouring time becomes a sky-mover in an instant; for time is the appearance of things, and that is of the nature of limitation.
